test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What does Article 243D of the Panchayat Constitution speak about?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Reservation of seats in Panchayat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Reservation of seats for women in Panchayats

 
 
• As per provisions contained in Article 243 D of the Constitution, 1/3rd of the Seats of Panchayati Raj Institutions and 1/3rd offices of the Chairperson at all levels of Panchayati Raj Institutions covered by Part IX of the Constitution are reserved for women. Hence, Option 4 is correct.
 
• The following states have made legal provisions for 50% reservation for women among members and Sarpanches: Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Kerala, Maharashtra, Orissa, Rajasthan, Tripura, and Uttarakhand.
